name: shiruten
description: Plugins by shiruten: demo-video records narrated demo videos of pull requests; session-rescue brings back desktop sessions that vanished from the Code tab.

plugins.name: demo-video
plugins.description: Record a narrated, captioned demo video of a pull request actually working, then attach it to the PR with gh.

plugins.name: session-rescue
plugins.description: Bring back a Claude Code desktop session that disappeared from the Code tab: unarchive it, or rebuild its sidebar card from the transcript still on disk.
